introduction: The issuex GitHub adapter provides a full implementation of the forge-neutral Client interface for GitHub REST API v3 / 2022-11-28, supporting repository inspection, issue tracking, and pull request workflows across github.com and GitHub Enterprise instances.

glossary.CheckRun: A GitHub Actions or external CI/CD check execution attached to a specific commit SHA.
glossary.EnterpriseEndpoint: A custom GitHub Enterprise Server or GitHub Enterprise Cloud API endpoint path.
glossary.MergeMethod: The pull request merge strategy: merge commit, squash and merge, or rebase and merge.
glossary.ReviewEvent: The GitHub pull request review event action, such as COMMENT, APPROVE, or REQUEST_CHANGES.
glossary.Truncated: A boolean flag indicating that comments or list results exceeded the fetch cap and more items exist on the server.

requirements.title: GitHub Client Construction, Lifecycle, and Factory Wiring
requirements.rationale: Direct construction and factory integration allow callers to instantiate authenticated or unauthenticated GitHub adapters configured for public or enterprise instances.

criteria.action: provide a GitHub client adapter struct that implements all methods of the Client interface and export the NewGitHub(Options) (Client, error) constructor

criteria.condition: NewGitHub is called with Options
criteria.action: resolve BaseURL from Options or GITHUB_API_URL or default to https://api.github.com without trailing slash, Token from Options or GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN, HTTPClient from Options or default 30-second timeout client, and UserAgent from Options or default agent-fox

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with NoOp set to false and the resolved forge type is ForgeTypeGitHub
criteria.action: construct and return the GitHub client adapter instead of returning ErrUnsupportedForge
report true from Authenticated() when holding a non-empty token and false otherwise, and close idle HTTP connections on the underlying transport from Close() returning nil

for any outgoing HTTP request, include Accept: application/vnd.github+json, X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28, and User-Agent headers, appending Authorization: Bearer <Token> when authenticated and Content-Type: application/json when a request body is present

requirements.title: Repository Metadata and Merge Policy Inspection
requirements.rationale: Repository inspection verifies repository accessibility, permissions, default branch, and allowed merge strategies for pull request automation.

criteria.condition: GetRepository is called with a valid Repo
criteria.action: execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name} and populate a Repository struct with FullName, DefaultBranch, Private, Archived, and Permissions booleans for Push, Pull, and Admin

criteria.condition: GetRepository receives a successful repository response
criteria.action: record the repository merge strategy booleans allow_merge_commit, allow_squash_merge, and allow_rebase_merge for pull request merge method resolution

criteria.condition: GetRepository receives HTTP 404 on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound with guidance indicating the repository may be private and require authentication
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing private repository guidance

criteria.condition: GetRepository receives HTTP 404 on an authenticated client
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true

requirements.title: Issue Lifecycle and Retrieval
requirements.rationale: Issue lifecycle methods enable creating, reading with full comment history, updating, closing, and filtered listing of forge issues.

criteria.condition: CreateIssue is called with a Repo and CreateIssueRequest on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues with title, body, and labels, returning the created Issue with Number, Title, Body, State, URL, Author, Labels, timestamps, and IsPR set to false

criteria.condition: CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, or CloseIssue is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

criteria.condition: ReadIssue is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}, set Issue.IsPR to true if the response contains a pull_request key, and fetch chronological comments via ListComments into IssueThread

criteria.condition: ReadIssue receives an error when fetching comments after successfully retrieving issue metadata
criteria.action: record the comment failure in IssueThread.CommentsErr and return the populated Issue with nil top-level error
criteria.contract: IssueThread has populated Issue, non-nil CommentsErr, and ReadIssue returns nil error

criteria.condition: ReadIssue receives HTTP 404 on an unauthenticated client
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound with guidance that the issue or repository may be private
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing private issue guidance

criteria.condition: UpdateIssue is called with an IssueRef and UpdateIssueRequest on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute PATCH /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number} with non-empty fields and return the updated Issue struct

criteria.condition: CloseIssue is called with an IssueRef and optional comment on an authenticated client
criteria.action: post the comment via AddComment if non-empty, and execute PATCH /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number} with state closed

criteria.condition: ListIssues is called with a Repo and IssueFilter
criteria.action: paginate GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues with state, labels, assignee, sort, and direction query parameters, exclude items containing a pull_request key, and set IssueList.Incomplete to true if results reach filter.Limit while additional issues remain

requirements.title: Issue Comments and Label Operations
requirements.rationale: Comments and labels provide issue interaction and triage categorization with idempotent mutation semantics.

criteria.condition: AddComment is called with an IssueRef and comment body on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/comments with the comment body and return the comment html_url

criteria.condition: ListComments is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: paginate GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/comments with 100 items per page up to a maximum cap of 5 pages (500 comments), setting CommentList.Truncated to true if the 5th page contains 100 items

criteria.condition: AddLabels is called with an IssueRef and a non-empty slice of label names on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/labels with the label names array

criteria.condition: AddLabels is called with an empty labels slice
criteria.action: return nil immediately without making network calls

criteria.condition: RemoveLabel is called with an IssueRef and label name on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute DELETE /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number}/labels/{label} with URL-escaped label name, returning nil when the response is HTTP 200 or HTTP 404

criteria.condition: CreateLabel is called with a Repo and Label on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/labels with name, hex color stripped of leading hash, and description, returning nil when the response is HTTP 201 or HTTP 422 with already_exists code

criteria.condition: AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, or CreateLabel is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

requirements.title: Pull Request Lifecycle and File Changes
requirements.rationale: Pull request operations support automated code review workflows, PR metadata inspection, and changed file analysis.

criteria.condition: CreatePullRequest is called with a Repo and CreatePullRequestRequest on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls with title, body, head, base, and draft flag, returning the created PullRequest struct with Merged set to false

criteria.condition: ReadPullRequest is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number} and return the parsed PullRequest struct with head branch, base branch, head SHA, draft status, and merge status

criteria.condition: ReadPullRequest receives HTTP 404 on an unauthenticated client
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound with guidance indicating the repository or pull request may be private
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing private repository guidance

criteria.condition: ReadChangedFiles is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/files and return a slice of ChangedFile structs with status normalized to added, modified, or deleted

criteria.condition: GetPRState is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number} and return a PRState struct with State set to merged when merged is true, closed when state is closed and merged is false, or open otherwise

criteria.condition: ClosePullRequest is called with an IssueRef on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute PATCH /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number} with state closed

criteria.condition: CreatePullRequest or ClosePullRequest is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

requirements.title: Pull Request Checks, Reviews, and Merge Execution
requirements.rationale: CI status checks, review commenting, and policy-aware pull request merging enable complete automation of review and integration pipelines.

criteria.condition: GetCIChecks is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: resolve the pull request head commit SHA via ReadPullRequest and execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/commits/{head_sha}/check-runs, returning mapped CheckRun structs

criteria.condition: GetPRReviews is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/reviews and return mapped Review structs with state normalized to approved, changes_requested, commented, or dismissed

criteria.condition: PostReviewComment is called with an IssueRef and body string on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/reviews with event COMMENT and body

criteria.condition: MergePullRequest is called with an explicit MergeMethod option on an authenticated client
criteria.action: map MergeMethodMerge to merge, MergeMethodSquash to squash, or MergeMethodRebase to rebase, and execute PUT /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/merge returning MergeResult on HTTP 200

criteria.condition: MergePullRequest is called with MergeMethodDefault on an authenticated client
criteria.action: query repository merge settings via GET /repos/{owner}/{name} and select the first enabled strategy from merge commit, squash, or rebase, falling back to omitting merge_method

criteria.condition: MergePullRequest receives HTTP 405 or HTTP 409 from GitHub
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrConflict indicating the pull request cannot be merged
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsConflict(err) == true

criteria.condition: PostReviewComment or MergePullRequest is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

requirements.title: GitHub REST Transport, Error Handling, and Rate Limiting
requirements.rationale: Bounded memory usage, rate-limit backoff with retry, and canonical error classification ensure resilience against GitHub API failures and throttling.

criteria.action: read all HTTP response bodies through an io.LimitReader bounded to at most 8 MB (8388608 bytes)

criteria.condition: an HTTP response has status 429 or status 403 with header X-RateLimit-Remaining 0
criteria.guard: the calculated RetryAfter backoff duration is less than or equal to 120 seconds
criteria.action: invoke the configured sleep function for the backoff duration and retry the request once

criteria.condition: an HTTP response has status 429 or status 403 with header X-RateLimit-Remaining 0 and the RetryAfter backoff exceeds 120 seconds, or a retried rate-limited request fails
criteria.action: abort the request and return an error wrapping ErrRateLimited
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsRateLimited(err) == true

criteria.action: for any GitHub REST error response payload containing a message and an errors array, format the HTTPError message by concatenating the message with field-level details from the errors array

criteria.condition: an HTTP response returns status 404, 409, or 405
criteria.action: wrap the corresponding sentinel error ErrNotFound for status 404 or ErrConflict for status 409 and 405 in the returned HTTPError

criteria.condition: a custom sleep function is configured on the GitHub client adapter
criteria.action: invoke the custom sleep function instead of time.Sleep during rate-limit backoff retries

execution_paths.title: GitHub issue creation, reading with comments, and closing with comment

steps.action: invokes NewGitHub with authentication token and repository target
constructs and returns an authenticated GitHub client
calls CreateIssue with title, body, and labels
executes POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues and returns the created Issue
calls ReadIssue for the created issue reference
executes GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{number} and fetches issue comments via ListComments
calls CloseIssue with an explanatory closing comment
executes AddComment to post the closing comment and PATCHes the issue state to closed

execution_paths.title: Pull request check runs inspection, review commenting, and repository-policy merge

steps.action: invokes NewWithOptions for a GitHub repository and calls ReadPullRequest
executes GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number} and returns PR details with head commit SHA
calls GetCIChecks to verify PR commit check run status
queries commit check runs and returns the status of each check
calls PostReviewComment with approval comments
executes POST /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/reviews with event COMMENT
calls MergePullRequest with MergeMethodDefault
queries repository merge settings, selects the allowed merge strategy, and executes PUT /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}/merge

execution_paths.title: Rate-limit backoff and retry recovery on GitHub REST request

steps.action: calls GetRepository on an authenticated GitHub client
executes GET /repos/{owner}/{name} and receives an HTTP 403 response with X-RateLimit-Remaining 0 and Retry-After header of 2 seconds
calculates the backoff duration via RetryAfter() and invokes the injected sleep function for the duration
retries the GET /repos/{owner}/{name} request once
receives HTTP 200 and returns the populated Repository struct to the caller
